Big questions about AI, made understandable.

Researchers, scientists, educators, philosophers, policymakers and builders have explored AI on The Ayush Prakash Podcast. Their ideas matter, but they are spread across long episodes and often expressed in specialist language.

CIF is turning those conversations into a free, interactive public record. Start with a question, read a clear explanation, compare perspectives and follow any idea back to its source. No technical background or institutional access required.

In memory of Aaron Swartz
i
Knowledge should be accessible to everyone.

Aaron Swartz’s belief that knowledge should be open shapes how this project is built. Institutions may help fund, host, or extend the work. Access remains public.

No paywall

No purchase or subscription.

No institutional gate

No university, employer, funder, partner, or professional affiliation.

No required email

No registration. Email is only for optional updates.

Inspectable sources

Every explanation links to its transcript, timestamp, and context.

Open to critique

CIF welcomes disagreement in public or private. Critiques grounded in clear reasoning and relevant evidence will be reviewed. Corrections will be made when warranted, and
